name: Blessing of Yogg-Saron's Faceless Monstrosity is drawn at player size, not boss size (#10521)
contract: Talent 807128 makes Herald of the Depths 520326 also apply 806769, whose SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM targets creature
250044 'Faceless Monstrosity'. Its display was 28844, the FacelessOne2 brute at DBC scale 4; transforms ignore
DisplayScale, so the Cultist was drawn at boss size. Display 280071 is the same model and skin at DBC scale 1
(#5707). Expected: with the talent, Herald leaves the Cultist on display 280071 at object scale 1.
